name: gsscode
abstract: UK ONS/GSS geography code type, packed into 32 bits
description: Packs a 9-character UK ONS/GSS statistical geography code (eg E01000001) into a 32-bit integer for fast indexing and prefix matching, on the same principle as the postcode extension. Includes %/!% prefix-match operators (single or array of prefixes), text-compatibility shims (~, ~*, LEFT()) for queries written against the original text column, isnan() for ONS's reserved/placeholder codes, and a private type-registry table (description()) seeded from and refreshable against the ONS Register of Geographic Codes.
